domain.note: s is local to this region's construction and is consistent with the project-wide convention w := sqrt(p) documented in docs/mathematical_conventions.md. It is NOT the w := R^(-1/2) used in theorem_4/05_upper_bridge's certificate; see proof/lower_bridge_proof.md, Section 1.

definitions.P: P(s) = s^6 * H(s^2, x(s)), the same pickled symbolic form (P_built.pkl) as theorem_4/01_lower_endpoint
definitions.G: G(w,Y) := w^2 * C_p(w^2, -1+w^2*Y), the defining equation of the stationary branch Y(w)

mesh_coverage.method: contiguity check on the archived tile boundaries
mesh_coverage.result: 464 tiles cover [0.00015, 0.15] exactly, with no gap and no overlap

per_tile_H_negative.method: interval arithmetic (mpmath mp.iv): mean-value enclosure of P on each tile from a certified branch box Y_B, margin -sup(Q) > MARGIN_TOL = 1e-12
per_tile_H_negative.result: P < 0, hence H = P/s^6 < 0 (s>0 throughout this domain), on each of the 464 tiles; minimum margin 1.013...e-8, maximum margin 6.04...e-3

branch_inclusion_per_tile.method: sign-bracketing of G at the edges of Y_B plus strict G_Y<0 on the tile box, same pattern as theorem_4/01_lower_endpoint/scripts/certify_Ppp_v2.py
branch_inclusion_per_tile.result: the true stationary branch Y(w) is certified contained in Y_B for every tile

tile_to_tile_stitching.method: hull of the two adjacent tiles' Y_B boxes at each shared boundary, re-checked for G_Y<0 and sign change of G at that boundary on the hull

independent_audit_level_1.method: structural: re-reads the archived per-tile and stitching bounds and re-checks every criterion from them, with no new symbolic or interval computation
independent_audit_level_1.result: PASS for 464/464 tiles and 463/463 stitchings, 0 violation

independent_audit_level_2.method: numerical: reconstructs the symbolic chain independently and re-evaluates every tile and stitching by interval arithmetic from the archived W/Y0/Y_B boxes alone
independent_audit_level_2.result: PASS for 464/464 tiles and 463/463 stitchings, 0 violation, 0 archive/re-evaluation discrepancy beyond 1e-30 serialization tolerance

junction_with_01_lower_endpoint.note: 01_lower_endpoint's domain is 0 < s <= 0.00015 (closed above); this region's domain is 0.00015 <= s <= 0.15 (closed below). The two regions share the single point s=0.00015 under an identical definition of P and H (same P_built.pkl); see proof/lower_bridge_proof.md, Section 6.

method.distinction: H<0 is established directly by interval mean-value enclosure of P on each tile (not an exact symbolic identity, and not a floating-point stress test): every bound reported here is a certified interval, independently re-evaluated at two separate audit levels (pilot_mesh_audit.py, pilot_mesh_audit_level2.py).

dependencies: theorem_4/01_lower_endpoint (shares P_built.pkl and the junction point s=0.00015)

scripts.role: builds and certifies the adaptive mesh over [0.00015, 0.15]; writes the archive

archive.role: complete per-tile and per-stitching certified bounds, consumed by both audit scripts
